'''Toibu Lawal''' (born 1 May 2003) is a British professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Dallas Mavericks]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA), on a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Texas Legends]] of the [[NBA G League]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[VCU Rams men's basketball|VCU Rams]] and [[Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball|Virginia Tech Hokies]].

==Early life and high school==
Lawal started playing basketball at the age of 16. He attended the [[City of London Academy, Southwark|City of London Academy]] basketball programme before heading to the [[Lee Academy (Maine)|Lee Academy]] in [[Lee, Maine]], for a prep year. <ref>{{cite web |last1=Neter |first1=Sam |title=Tobi Lawal gets drafted with 48th pick to Dallas Mavericks |url=https://www.hoopsfix.com/2026/06/tobi-lawal-gets-drafted-with-48th-pick-to-dallas-mavericks/ |website=Hoopsfix |date=25 June 2026 |access-date=25 June 2026}}</ref> Lawal averaged 14.5 points, 11.4 rebounds and 3.0 blocks per game. Coming out of high school, he committed to play [[college basketball]] for the [[VCU Rams men's basketball|VCU Rams]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Wilson |first1=Arrick |title=From across the pond: London native adapts to VCU basketball |url=https://commonwealthtimes.org/2022/11/09/from-across-the-pond-london-native-adapts-to-vcu-basketball/ |website=The Commonwealth Times |date=9 November 2022 |access-date=17 June 2026}}</ref>

==College career==
As a [[freshman]] during the 2022-23 season, Lawal played sparingly, averaging 1.3 points per game.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Pearrell |first1=Tim |title=Springy VCU freshman Tobi Lawal ‘a threat vertically’ |url=https://richmond.com/sports/college/schools/virginia-commonwealth-university/springy-vcu-freshman-tobi-lawal-a-threat-vertically/article_f5bc8294-b6e0-11ed-adf1-eba3066ac3b2.html |website=Richmond Times-Dispatch |access-date=17 June 2026}}</ref> In the 2023-24 season, he averaged 7.7 points and 6.0 rebounds in 38 games played. After the season, Lawal entered the [[NCAA transfer portal]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Wartooth |first1=Hokie |title=Hokies Add High-Flying VCU Transfer Toibu Lawal |url=https://247sports.com/college/virginia-tech/article/hokies-add-high-flying-vcu-transfer-toibu-lawal-230980036/ |website=247Sports |access-date=17 June 2026}}</ref>

Lawal transferred to play for the [[Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball|Virginia Tech Hokies]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Joachim |first1=Zach |title=VCU hoops transfer portal updates: Fan favorite Lawal departs for Virginia Tech |url=https://richmond.com/sports/college/basketball/men/article_b2ed68f6-03fc-11ef-9359-d74115516bbc.html |website=Richmond Times-Dispatch |access-date=17 June 2026}}</ref> In 2024-25, he made 30 starts, averaging 12.4 points and 7.0 rebounds per game.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Hawkins |first1=Kenny |title=Virginia Tech men’s basketball player Tobi Lawal returns to the hokies |url=https://www.wjhl.com/sports/college-sports-2/virginia-tech-mens-basketball-player-tobi-lawal-returns-to-the-hokies/ |website=WJHL.com |access-date=17 June 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Graham |first1=Chris |title=Quote machine Tobi Lawal should be a UVA Basketball recruiting target |url=https://augustafreepress.com/news/quote-machine-tobi-lawal-should-be-a-uva-basketball-recruiting-target/ |website=Augusta Free Press |access-date=17 June 2026}}</ref> On November 16, 2025, Lawal racked up 18 points and 15 rebounds in a victory versus [[2025–26 Charlotte 49ers men's basketball team|Charlotte]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Berman |first1=Mark |title=Lawal helps Virginia Tech fend off Charlotte |url=https://roanoke.com/sports/college/basketball/virginia-tech-hokies/men/article_957696b7-a943-47ea-a3e9-b61729c22532.html |website=Roanoke Times |access-date=17 June 2026}}</ref> He played 23 games with 17 starts, averaging 12.3 points, 8.5 rebounds, and 1.1 blocks per game, while shooting 54% from the field.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Hughes |first1=Thomas |title=Could Hokies Forward Tobi Lawal Be A Second-Round 2026 NBA Draft Pick? |url=https://www.si.com/college/virginiatech/basketball/could-hokies-forward-tobi-lawal-be-a-second-round-2026-nba-draft-pick-01ktz7nk9503 |website=Virginia Tech Hokies On SI |access-date=17 June 2026}}</ref> After the season, Lawal declared for the [[2026 NBA draft]], accepting an invite to the NBA scouting combine.<ref>{{cite web |title=Lawal, Onyenso receive invites to NBA Draft Combine |url=https://www.wsls.com/sports/2026/05/01/lawal-onyenso-receive-invites-to-nba-draft-combine/ |website=WSLS.com |date=1 May 2026 |access-date=17 June 2026}}</ref>

==Professional career==
On June 24, 2026, Lawal was selected by the [[Dallas Mavericks]] with the 48th overall pick in the [[2026 NBA draft]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Myers |first1=Doug |title=Mavericks add Tobi Lawal of Virginia Tech with the No. 48 pick in 2026 NBA Draft|url=https://www.cbsnews.com/texas/news/mavericks-2026-draft-second-round-pick-dusty-may-rebuild/|website=[[CBS Sports]]|access-date=24 June 2026}}</ref> On July 3, 2026, he signed a standard [[two-way contract]] with the Mavericks.<ref name="HoopsRumors_Lawal">{{cite web |last=Maher |first=Rory |url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2026/07/mavericks-sign-second-rounder-tobi-lawal-to-two-way-deal.html |title=Mavericks Sign Second-Rounder Tobi Lawal To Two-Way Deal |website=Hoops Rumors |date=July 3, 2026 |access-date=July 3, 2026}}</ref> That same day, Lawal was announced to be participating with the Mavericks in the [[2026 NBA Summer League]], where he appeared in all five games, during those games, he averaged 5.8 points, 3.8 rebounds, and 0.8 assists.<ref name="DMN_MavsSummer2026">{{cite web |last=Curtis |first=Mike |url=https://www.dallasnews.com/sports/mavericks/article/summer-league-roster-morez-johnson-nembhard-sergio-22331856.php |title=Mavericks reveal Summer League roster featuring Morez Johnson, Ryan Nembhard Jr., Sergio de Larrea |website=[[The Dallas Morning News]] |date=July 3, 2026 |access-date=July 3, 2026}}</ref><ref name="realgmmavssummerleague">{{cite web|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/nba/teams/Dallas-Mavericks/6/Rosters/Summer_League|title=2026 Dallas 2026 NBA Summer League Stats|website=[[RealGM]] |date=July 17, 2026 |access-date=July 18, 2026}}</ref>
